findings.summary: Holding and releasing the actual recovery lease replaces scheduler timing with an explicit boundary; if the production resolver stops classifying busy retirement or invoking its wait path, the test cannot reach the coordination point.
findings.broken_invariant: Compatibility evaluator facade requires independent review evidence.

hidden_assumptions: The resolver's initial active-claim read remains part of the production precondition; its removal correctly causes this integration test to fail and require review.
